records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Gross margin dollars decreased $38.7 million, while gross margin rate decreased 160 basis points to 38.9% of net sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Comparable sales for stores open at least fifteen months, plus our e-commerce operations, decreased $62.2 million, or 4.7%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Inventory increased by 17.3%, or $188.2 million, to $1,277.2 million from the third quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin dollars decreased $38.7 million, or 6.9%, to $519.2 million for the third quarter of 2021, compared to $557.9 million for the third quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •Operating (loss) profit decreased to an operating loss of $4.1 million from an operating profit of $42.5 million.
